name: io.github.tonyyang0504/udbud_dk-mcp
description: Udbud (deals): me, search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UDBUD_DK_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: client_id issued by Udbud.dk / Erhvervsstyrelsen after registering your system (registration form linked from the SDK README) with the MU_API_DATASYNK role.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UDBUD_DK_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PEM RSA private key whose public key you expose in the JWKS endpoint registered with Udbud.dk (private_key_jwt client assertion, RS256).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UDBUD_DK_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: kid of that key in your JWKS.
